matching_criterion_description: Ectopia lentis is completely absent (0% penetrance) across verified LDS types including LDS6; finding lens subluxation points toward FBN1-related Marfan syndrome or homocystinuria.
Premature fusion of cranial sutures is absent or exceedingly rare in typical SMAD2-associated LDS6 families.
Cognitive development is typically normal in familial SMAD2 cohorts; its presence indicates alternative diagnoses such as Shprintzen-Goldberg syndrome.
